objective: Add two durable operating loops to Ron OS: skill-capital development and social-capital development, without collapsing existing learning, XMind/social-life, finance, scheduling, or permission ownership.

roles_before.artifact: references/domain-routing.md XMind social-relationships composition + direct Ron evidence

role_dispositions.destination: Learning remains responsible for concrete study/language systems; skill-capital only ranks and compounds transferable capability investments.
XMind/strategy remains the map; skill-capital becomes a supporting domain when capability choice materially affects the outcome.
Ordinary relationship goals remain XMind/context/direct-evidence owned, while professional/opportunity network building routes to the new social-capital skill and owner.
Registry remains authoritative and explicitly adds both new domain owners.
Both new owners are discoverable from BOOTSTRAP.md, CURRENT.md, domain-routing.md and the registry.
No Calendar/TickTick/contacts/messages or other external writes are authorized by these new systems without task-specific permission.
Base SHA, candidate branch, manifest and Git history retain full rollback/provenance.

capability_probes.assertion: A German-study or exam-learning request still routes to learning rather than being swallowed by skill-capital.
The new social-capital domain must not reinterpret family/friendship/romantic relationship work as networking or instrumentalize ordinary social life.
Existing finance and nutrition owners/routes remain registered and discoverable after adding the new domains.
The pre-change architecture remains recoverable from base SHA ec06877c12a2468a882b54f7512884156a0f85b0 and Git history.

tests.expected: PASS: both new skills/owners are registered, routed, discoverable, scoped and initialized without fabricated current state.
A reusable loop exists for opportunity scan -> rank by expected compounding value -> deliberate practice/application -> evidence -> review, with no invented active skill.

A reusable loop exists for target circles -> value-first contact -> relationship maintenance -> reciprocity -> opportunity review, with privacy/non-instrumental boundaries and no invented contact inventory.

tests.command: python tests/architecture_change_guard.py && python tests/architecture_change_guard_selftest.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard_selftest.py

tests.expected: PASS: learning, finance, nutrition and ordinary social-relationship routing remain intact.
